note: Which model each stage runs on. Every entry below is deliberately EMPTY: the models have not been chosen yet, and writing a plausible slug here would be indistinguishable from a decision nobody made. An empty entry resolves exactly as the pipeline did before this file existed -- CLI flag, then environment, then llm_providers.DEFAULT_PROVIDER. Fill an entry in and it takes effect for that stage without touching any code. Stages absent from this file (intake, indexing) make no provider call.

document_processing.note: Fans out to several roles. The two P8 readers are only genuinely independent if they are given DIFFERENT models; leaving both empty means one model reads twice, which harness-guardrails-dev records as a weak P8 either way. Only the roles with a consumer are listed -- classification and the segmentation judge resolve their own provider today and get an entry when their code reads this file.

policy_clause_processing.note: Deterministic today -- the driver records provider_name 'deterministic' and makes no call. Listed so its absence of a model is a stated fact rather than an omission.

claim_analysis.note: Its driver resolves its provider from --provider/--model today; it gets an entry with roles when it reads this file.

consistency_check.note: The judgement runs either as the consistency-check subagent or as `run_consistency_check.py judge`. This entry applies to the driver route only -- a subagent's model is the session's, which this file cannot set.
